The Proposal -
To conserve the lakes, rivulets and large water bodies in the state from an ecological point of view.
The State Government has launched the State Lake Conservation Scheme under the State Plan from this financial year 2006-07.
It has started. The plan typically includes the following tasks:
1. To take measures to prevent pollution by identifying polluting sources of lake water.
2. Removal of necessary hazardous and organic silt accumulated in the lake.
3. To maintain the quality of the lake,
A. To control the growth of the lake by destroying unnecessary and harmful plants.
to take measures.
B. Improving the quality of lake water through biological processes in the lake.
C. Beach beautification, developing green belts, fencing, for recreation
Children's parks, boating, low-cost toilets, etc.
4. Programmes for public participation and awareness generation and prevention of pollution as per local conditions.
